requirement: The Tracy community on Discord is one press away: a Community row above Settings in the left column, and a floating Need help? pill in the conversation that opens a panel with Open Discord and can be hidden per browser, after which the row stays

oracle.ref: PR #922 (feat); fix evidence: 05/10/2026: customers need one place to ask questions, report bugs and share feedback with the team and each other. Variant chosen on two HTML mock pages (option E floating pill + option A footer row): the pill sits in the chat column, not the screen corner, because the screen corner is the site preview where a site's own chat widget lives (measured overlap on the mock).
